title: Fix layered config loading
instruction: Fix config layering. src/merge.mjs deepMerge(base, override) returns a new object: plain objects merge recursively, arrays and all other values from override replace base values, keys whose override value is undefined keep the base value, and neither input is mutated. src/env.mjs fromEnv(env, prefix) maps variables such as APP_SERVER__PORT=8080 (with prefix 'APP_') to { server: { port: 8080 } }: '__' separates nesting levels, keys become lowercase, values 'true'/'false' become booleans, values matching /^-?\d+$/ become numbers, everything else stays a string; variables without the prefix are ignored. src/load.mjs loadConfig(defaults, fileConfig, env) applies defaults < fileConfig < env using these helpers with prefix 'APP_'.

acceptanceCriteria: env nesting, casing and type coercion
